benchmark_caveats.comparison_is_per_association: read cost is the battery total divided by items probed, so the ratio does not move when the item count changes. It moved when the first version divided by the wrong denominator, and that is how the bug was seen.
benchmark_caveats.reference_understates_inference: the reference loop spends the donor-matrix operations a generation pays and omits attention between activations, softmax and the KV cache. Every ratio here therefore FLATTERS the read side; a real inference cost would make reading look better, not worse.
benchmark_caveats.wall_clock_is_shape_valid_content_free: these shapes and this code path give a real seconds-per-association, but on a synthetic donor the associations being compared are not GPT-2's, so the figure bounds the machinery and not the finding.

benchmark_vs_reference_inference.counting_note: attention between activation vectors touches no donor parameter matrix, so under the registered counting rule it is not an operation on either side

1_ten_x_is_a_function_of_query_length_th.consequence: H2 cannot be scored until 'equivalent association query' has a token length. It is registered as D-MPE12-05, and the plan's own wording does not settle it.
1_ten_x_is_a_function_of_query_length_th.finding: the pre-registered 10x threshold is crossed at 5 generated tokens on operation count, 9 on MACs, and NONE OF THE REGISTERED LENGTHS on wall-clock
1_ten_x_is_a_function_of_query_length_th.note_on_none: a null crossing is the finding, not a missing measurement

2_the_read_is_slower_than_generating_one.both_sides_have_unpriced_work_in_opposit: the read side INCLUDES ranking 50,257 logits twice and constructing every node and edge; the reference side OMITS attention between activations, softmax and the KV cache, which a real generation pays. So this ratio is not favourable to the read by construction, and it is not unfavourable either -- it is two different amounts of work, and the honest statement is that neither side here is a full cost model.
2_the_read_is_slower_than_generating_one.finding: at k=1 the read costs 0.6974x the reference generation -- below 1.0 means SLOWER
2_the_read_is_slower_than_generating_one.why: the read pays two full vocabulary-sized multiplies (the embedding search and the tied unembedding) in one shot, while a one-token generation pays one of them plus smaller per-layer work that numpy runs faster than the sort and node-building the read does.

3_the_vocabulary_is_where_the_budget_goe.consequence: any attempt to widen the probe battery (more heads, more layers, motifs across more of the model) is nearly free in operations and expensive in MACs. The budget counts operations, so it does not see this -- a registered limitation of the counting rule, not of this run.
3_the_vocabulary_is_where_the_budget_goe.finding: 72.8% of the read's MACs are the two wte multiplies; the twelve MLP reads and eight head reads together are the rest

4_the_registered_budget_has_one_operatio.consequence: the extraction that would have asked which token each head map is nearest to was dropped during implementation because it costs 4 more operations, which would abort every item. That is the budget doing its job, and it is also the budget binding before the science does.
4_the_registered_budget_has_one_operatio.what_would_have_been_missed_if_the_budge: nothing -- the cost of a looser budget is paid by H2, which is the comparison this file exists to make

5_weight_tying_is_visible_as_a_shape_not.caveat: on random weights that number describes geometry, not knowledge. It is here because the instrument should be seen reporting the quantity the plan's superposition risk names, not because this donor has a superposition to report.
5_weight_tying_is_visible_as_a_shape_not.finding: extraction 1 and extraction 2 both read wte; on this donor their top-k sets overlap with mean Jaccard 0.3636

energy_estimate: NOT MEASURED -- no energy instrument in this repository (D-MPE12-02)

quoting_guard.meaning: The donor is synthetic. No association, neighbour, motif or confidence figure in this artifact is evidence about GPT-2, because this donor is not GPT-2 and holds no library. Operation counts, shapes and MAC totals ARE valid measurements here: they are properties of the code path and the registered shapes.
